name: RC-B10-0101/2025 – After § 4 – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
part_text: 4a. Recalls the international efforts to fight Islamic terrorist groups, such as Boko Haram and Islamic State West Africa Province, who are attacking, killing and displacing Nigerians and, in particular, Christians; urges Nigeria to immediately take action to fight against and prevent these terrorist attacks;
